notes.title: 【Points shop items Now Out】Discount Incoming! & 5.10 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear agents!

We’ve just released a new update, fixing various issues that have impacted your gameplay experience. You can find detailed update information in the patch notes below. Plus, mark your calendars for our upcoming week-long Discount, offering [b]18% OFF from May 11 to May 18[/b], with trading cards and points shop items available at the same time. Should you encounter any bugs or issues post-update, please don't hesitate to[url=https://discord.gg/reversecollapse] join our official Discord[/url] and report them. notes.title: 04-19 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear agents!
We will be rolling out an update addressing the adjustments to the “stealth experience” and “Casual Mode”, while fixing various issues that have impacted your gameplay experience. Currently, the update is in its final QA stage. You can find detailed update information in the patch notes below.

Should you encounter any bugs or issues post-update, please don't hesitate to join [url=https://discord.gg/reversecollapse]our official Discord[/url] and report them. Your feedback is invaluable, and we're committed to promptly addressing any concerns you may have. Thank you for your continued patience and support.

[h3]04-19 Patch Notes[/h3]
[b][Stealth Related Adjustments][/b]
[olist]
[*] Added target selection tips when checking the locations and moving routes of enemy searchlights.
[*] Added item trait “Enemy Detection” to “Scanner” and “Advanced Scanner”. It will increase view range at the start of each turn and can be triggered up to 2 times.
[*] Chapter 4: The Rescue: Items preventing characters from getting exposed are not disabled anymore.
[*] The SP cost of Mendo’s skill “Silencing Strike” is adjusted to 0, and if enemy is not defeated after use, the target will enter “Asleep” status, reducing evasion by 50.
[*] Item “Sonar Scanner” is now available for Item Production in the Preparation Phase of Chapter 2, Act 6: Approach. For save files already unlocked this act, loading to any Preparation Phase or selecting “Restart Battle” during missions will also enable Item Production of the item.
[*] Added new item “Detection Interference Program”, which will reduce all of enemy’s normal visual range to Anti-Stealth Visual Range after use for one turn. This item is limited and can be obtained in certain missions.
[*] Adjusted Chapter 2, Act 9: Hunting Game and Chapter 4: Deep in the Tiger's Den: If player’s units are not exposed before entering the base, then the searchlight routes can be viewed after entering the base.
[*] Adjusted certain terrain that may affect gameplay experience in Chapter 4: Midnight Stratagem.
[/olist]
[b][Casual Mode Related Adjustments][/b]
In order to create a more relaxing gaming experience for players not very familiar with SLG or SRPG, we’ve made some new adjustments to the “Casual” mode of the game:
[olist]
[*] Added “Casual²” mode: After selecting “Casual” mode when starting a new game, players will have the option to enable “Casual²” mode. When this mode is selected, players will gain additional healing items “Pill” in every mission. And in battles, allied units will be healed 50% of their Max HP at the start of each turn (excluding certain special missions). Players already started the game can also switch to “Casual²” mode through “Menu - Select Difficulty”.
[*] More experience after finishing missions in the early stage of the game.
[*] More experience after finishing Training Simulations.
[*] Enemy Bosses have 30% less attack, -30 Accuracy and -15 Evasion (excluding Super Mutant Lambda, Reflection of the Progenitor and False Heart).
[*] In the first playthrough, the Level Cap of Team is set to 70.
[/olist]
[b][Other Adjustments and Optimization][/b]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted “Standard” mode to allow unlimited manual saves each turn.
[*] Chapter 1, Act 3: Narrow Escape: Now “Autonomous Recon Vehicle” cannot gain access to “Bridge Terminal Passcode”. Prior to the update, doing so will cause the game to stuck.
[*] Chapter 2, Act 9: Hunting Game: After finishing the objectives in the first phase, during the cutscene all deployed Equipment-type Items will be returned to the backpack. Prior to the update, enemies discovering Equipment-type Items could cause errors in the cutscene played after.
[*] Added voice when Tactical Dolls, Beria, Kirill, Lige (in special missions) and some enemy bosses use certain skills.
[*] Adjusted the Carrying Capacity of item “Pill” in backpack to 99.
[*] Optimized the performance when Atena, Jevon and Carl are defeated with Puppet status.
[*] Optimized some art assets.
[/olist]
[b][Fixes][/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an error where Mendo’s skill “Silencing Strike” could cause incorrect damage.
[*] Fixed an issue where Atena’s trait “Steady” doesn’t stop Ability Decrease caused by enemy trait “Shrike Diffusion”.
[*] Fixed a bug when occasionally dragging the item “Pill” around in Battle Backpack may cause the game to freeze. 
[*] Fixed a problem where items “Blood Bullet” and “Soporific Dart” don’t have shooting animation when used by Betty, Abigail, Ruby and Valmet.
[*] Fixed an issue where under certain circumstances players won’t be able to continue playing the game for a while after using “Shockwave Grenade” and blowing enemy units away.
[*] Fixed missing on-hit animation when “Reflection of the Progenitor” is attacked by “Electric Turret”.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Details page of Blood Cocoons doesn’t have the trait “Bloody Assimilation”.
[*] Fixed incomplete skill description of “Jamming Area” owned by “Wide Area Electronic Jammer”.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 1, Act 3: Narrow Escape: Certain enemies in the stronghold may wrongly switch their behavior modes.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 1, Act 3: Narrow Escape: Occasionally the story after finishing the first phase cannot be skipped.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 3, Act 7: Trap: “Cruise Missile” cannot be used to destroy Energy Supply Room.
[*] Fixed some terrain deployment errors in Chapter 4: High Ground Setup.
[*] Fixed a problem in Chapter 4: High Ground Setup Second Phase: After choosing to retreat, the disabled items are incorrect.
[*] Fixed a problem in Chapter 4: High Ground Setup Second Phase: After choosing to retreat, Battlefield Preparation doesn’t have Recommended Items.
[*] Fixed a problem in Chapter 4: High Ground Setup: Certain units will still trigger and start dialog after defeated.
[*] Fixed some missing cutscene sound effects in Chapter 4: The Rescue.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 4: Caged Bird: When entering the battlefield for a very short moment Skyscraper can be seen as already destroyed.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 4: Midnight Stratagem: When players’ units are discovered by the enemies, the visual range of Shrike Mitotic Specimens is not changed to Recon.
[*] Fixed an issue in Chapter 4: Eviction Notice: Units may overlap in the final cutscene.
[*] Fixed an issue where players cannot enter Chapter 5, Act 1: The Grateful Dead after watching the opening story of Chapter 5.

notes.title: Apr. 12th Patch Note - Art Book Expansion & Movement Confirmation Mode
notes.notes:
Greetings, dear agents!
We will be rolling out an update today. As discussed in previous announcements, it includes Art Book expansion, a new “Movement Confirmation Mode” for Keyboard & Mouse, and fixes addressing various issues that have impacted your gameplay experience. Currently, the update is in its final QA stage. You can find detailed update information in the patch notes below.

[h3]Apr. 12th Patch Notes:[/h3]
[b][New Additions][/b]
[olist]
[*] Art Book has 54 new pages now, to a total of 124 pages.
[*] Added a new “Movement Confirmation Mode” option for Keyboard & Mouse: if “Double-Click” is selected, the movement action will only be performed after double clicking the Left Mouse Button on the target tile.
[/olist]
[b][Optimizations and Adjustments][/b]
[olist]
[*] Chapter 4: Midnight Stratagem: It is now allowed to get exposed. The first three Phase Objectives were adjusted to “All Shrike Mitotic Specimens and Lige are either defeated or hypnotized by the Hypnotic Trap”, the Victory Objective in the final phase remains the same.
[*] Chapter 1, Act 3: Narrow Escape: the first phase and Chapter 4: High Ground Setup: the second phase: Items preventing characters from getting exposed are not disabled anymore. Chapter 4: The Rescue will be adjusted in the next update.
[*] Chapter 5, Act 3: Die Another Day: the first phase: After Atena finishing the Phase Objective and reaching the airport control tower, this location won’t have URNC soldiers turning into puppets.
[*] Chapter 3, Act 5: Base Infiltration and Chapter 4: Night Scouting: For controller users the cursor will be hovering over Carl by default when turn starts.

[*] Starting from the 2nd playthrough, save files of Chapter 5 - Final Act: Wish Fulfilled Preparation Phase can not be inherited anymore. Inheriting the save was causing data error before the update.
[*] Optimized some SFX volume.
[*] Enhanced several textures and art.

[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where defeating Blood Cocoon or Blood Cocoon defeating wrapped units will cause the game to freeze.
[*] Fixed an issue that controller users are not able to select certain sentences when viewing voice replay.

[*] Fixed issues in Chapter 4: Snow Mountain Interception and Enticement: The effect of Jevon’s Ultimate Skill happening in the cutscene will be carried to the real battle.
[*] Fixed an issue when Field Surveying Chapter 4: Forward Pressure during preparation phase, certain “AA-03 Autonomous Mechs” were not properly shown.

[*] Fixed a terrain description error of the “Booby-Trap” created by enemies in Chapter 5 - Final Act: Wish Fulfilled.
[*] Fixed an issue where “Simple Turret” will appear in the Synthesis Catalog when playing “Bakery Girl 2092R” Chapter 2: The First Battle.
[*] Fixed an issue that level 4 “Rocket Launcher” doesn’t cause splash damage when destroying “URNC Transporter” in Chapter 3, Act 4: Camouflage.
[*] Starting from the 2nd playthrough, “Advanced Upgrade Blueprint” dropped by β Shrike was missing in Chapter 3, Act 8: Battle of the Peak. It’s now fixed and if you’ve defeated the Boss before, loading the save after this patch will grant the missing blueprint(s).

notes.title: （updated）03-29 RC patch note
notes.notes:
Hello agents,

Today we will be rolling out an update addressing the significant adjustments to the stealth missions, as communicated in our previous developer logs, and fixing various issues that have impacted your gameplay experience. Currently, the update is in its final QA stage and is expected to be released later today. You can find detailed update information and stealth mission adjustments in the patch note below.

[h3][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h3]

[b]New Additions:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Added animation skip function: The game's setting intro animation in the beginning and the opening animation when entering Chapter 2 can now be skipped.
[*] Added a failsafe mechanism for "Blood Bullets" data errors. After the update, if you encounter this issue, reloading your last save should fix this issue. The root cause of this issue is still under investigation, and a complete fix will be included in future updates.
[*] Added the "Quick confirm with Controller" option in settings. Enabling this option allows actions like "entering stealth" and "repairing" to be executed without a second confirmation, only available for controllers.
[/olist]

[b]Stealth Mission Optimization: [/b]
We conducted the first round of optimization on stealth missions. Most missions now can be completed with direct combat strategies. However, to balance stealth and combat, choosing combat in stealth missions may trigger enemy reinforcements on some maps. Notably, the "Duty Room" in the base functions as originally implemented, dispatching enemy troops upon player unit detection or enemy alert. Please refer to the following for specific adjustments.[b] All adjusted campaign missions can still be completed by stealth.[/b]
[list][*] Chapter 2-6: Struggle for Survival: Adjusted to allow detection, with all enemy units lowered to level 13, and victory conditions unchanged. Also, a hidden shortcut is added at release, go explore! 

[*] Chapter 2-9: Hunting Game: Adjusted to allow detection. After players being exposed, the base will receive several enemy reinforcements, with victory conditions changed to all units reaching the designated location in the upper left corner of the map. Note that players lack means to confront the "Svarog" heavy tank on the right at this point in the playthrough. Additionally, the enemy commander's "Office Keycard" can be obtained by defeating them post-update.

[*] Chapter 3-1: Night Crisis: Upgraded the lighting equipment in the amusement park.

[*] Chapter 3-5: Base Infiltration: Adjusted to allow Jefuti and Mendo to be detected. Post-exposure, the base's duty room will receive enemy reinforcements, but Carl and the URNC soldiers in the dormitory area won't join the battle. Phase and victory goals remain unchanged. Carl can divert all guards in the upper area in a special way if Jefuti and Mendo remain unexposed. Moreover, the "Experiment Building Keycard" that Karl needs to search for during the campaign will be located at the specified position at the beginning of the second phase post-update. Correct dialogue is no longer required to obtain it, but an orange column of light will appear at the location after the conversation is completed.

[*] Chapter 4: High Ground Setup: Changed the first phase's goal to "Defeat all enemy units" or "All friendly characters remain unexposed and reach the designated location." Choosing combat will trigger a small wave of enemy reinforcements, while the second phase design remains unchanged.

[*] Chapter 4: Night Scouting: Adjusted to allow Jefuti and Mendo to be detected. Post-exposure, the base's duty room will receive enemy reinforcements, but Carl won't join the battle. Stage and victory goals remain unchanged.

[*] Chapter 4: Secret War: Adjusted to allow detection. Choosing combat will trigger a wave of enemy reinforcements, and the URNC transport truck will no longer appear. Victory conditions remain unchanged.

[*] Chapter 4: The Rescue: Still a mandatory stealth mission, but Carl can divert all stationed units across the map in a special way during the second phase.

[*] Chapter 5-3: Die Another Day: The interior part remains a mandatory stealth mission, but a hidden shortcut has been added.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/adef922b374f8926069dede512ef02295e6681a4.png[/img]

Please note that these adjustments will require re-entering the campaign post-update to take effect. Playing with save files from the original battles may cause some errors. Additionally, adjusting "Chapter 4: Midnight Stratagem" presents significant challenges, so adjustments to this mission will be updated in the future.

[b]Other Adjustments and Optimizations[/b]
[olist]
[*] Refined the additional objective descriptions in Chapter 3-4, "Camouflage."
[*] Streamlined various controller settings:
[list]
[*] Standardized the controls for "Repair" and "Recall" of "Tool" items for controllers.
[*] Limited the visibility of the "Controller Camera Mode" option to controller mode only.
[*] Eliminated redundant options such as "Quick Attack" from the controller settings.
[/list]
[*] Enhanced the clarity of certain text entries in the Japanese version of "Keyword."
[*] Improved the readability of selected text entries in the English version of "Keyword."
[*] Enhanced several textures and art.
[*] Adjusted the visibility range of map edges for better navigation.
[*] Special Adjustment: Identified an issue in Chapter 4, "Dead End," where incorrect snow texture on a house in the lower-left corner of the map is causing players to spend excessive time searching for collectibles. As a solution, we've chosen to preserve this distinctive terrain and introduced 12 "Airstrike Missiles" in this area. Following the update, players who have unlocked the "Airstrike Missiles" can explore this stage to obtain resources (limited to one use per playthrough).
[/olist]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Resolved an issue where total playtime is incorrectly displayed in save files.
[*] Addressed the problem of the "Autonomous Recon Vehicle" can clear the player team's tripwires with the "Trap Disassembly" skill.
[*] Fixed an inconsistency in Chapter 2-7, "Hell's Paradise," where despite “Lige?” being knocked down by Mendo's "Alert Area" in the first phase, the attack would still inflict damage in the second phase.
[*] Resolved an issue in Chapter 5-3, "Die Another Day," where the target location lacked directional indicator markings.
[*] Addressed a problem where enemy units in Search Mode would occasionally circle around our critically wounded units.
[*] Fixed the inability of "Oryx" and "Melt Bomb" to reduce the armor of "Quarantine Zone Gates" and enemy barrier-type units.
[*] Rectified various performance issues caused by tripwires during specific scenes.
[*] Fixed the "Electric Turret" not able to enter Stealth Mode issue.
[*] Fixed the issue where the replaying the opening animation in "Collection-Battle Records", other background music would still play in the back.
[*] Resolved an issue where game achievement progression couldn't synchronize with Steam in certain cases.
[*] Corrected instances where items and skills targeting "Mechanical" units failed to affect Sugar's "Holographic Doppelgangers."
[*] Fixed an issue where Lige has no breathing animation when in “Mirror Self” outfit.
[*] Addressed difficulties in hearing the exposed warning alert sound clearly in certain scenarios.
[*] Corrected discrepancies between sound effects and visuals when the "Svarog" heavy tank launched missiles during specific map events.
[*] Fixed the reappearance of the UI when taking screenshots using the screenshot key after hiding the UI.
[*] Resolved issues where players could access "Item Ascension," "Item Production," and "Item Synthesis" in Chapter 4, "Blood Horror."
[*] Fixed display inconsistencies in various interfaces.
[*] Corrected errors in some tutorials.
[*] Addressed animation glitches.
[*] Resolved the issue of players in the Thailand region being unable to access the game.
[*] Fixed certain Chinese, Japanese, and English text errors.
[/olist]

This update includes a lot of adjustments. Should you encounter any bugs or issues post-update, please don't hesitate to join our[url=https://discord.gg/reversecollapse] official Discord[/url] and report them. Your feedback is invaluable, and we're committed to promptly addressing any concerns you may have. Thank you for your continued patience and support.

notes.title: Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery Set to Release on March 22!
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow players!

Over the past year, our team has journeyed through numerous closed tests and offline gatherings with the community. We've also offered a free demo during Steam Next Fest in last June, and Strategy Game Fest, gathering invaluable feedback and suggestions from our passionate players.

With the completion of adding voice acting, we've entered the home stretch. Today, we're thrilled to officially announce that the game will be released on [b]March 22[/b]. This time, it's the full game, not a demo!

Check out our latest Release Date Announcement Trailer here: 

[previewyoutube=lk1G-1LF6-4;full][/previewyoutube]
Reverse Collapse holds special significance for the entire development team as it is the remake of our first-ever project: Bakery Girl. Through tireless development and refinement, our remade version aims to transcend visual boundaries and innovate in gameplay, storyline intricacies, and audio performance:

[b]Delving Deeper into Story and Character Development[/b]
Our fans may have noticed numerous new CG scenes in the latest trailer. By fully exploring storyline details, character developments, and subplots, we aim to transform the 300,000+ words from mere digits into a rich, immersive narrative experience.

[b]Expanded Level Design, Special Mechanics, and Secrets[/b]
As previously revealed, Jefuty's mysterious "Visual Leap" ability opens up a world of possibilities for the story, with over 60 mainline stages across different story branches. In addition to upgraded combat mechanics from the original, we've integrated terrain effects, formidable bosses, and special mechanics to offer a diverse gaming experience, estimated to provide around 100 hours of gameplay. 

Furthermore, to enrich your gaming journey, we've hidden collectibles and secrets throughout each map for players to discover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/9a91ea2777d436611c58b3c84d4ff22907358182.gif[/img]

[b]Implementation of Japanese Voice Acting[/b]
The highly-anticipated Japanese voice acting, confirmed since the store page went live, is currently undergoing final implementation testing. Thanks to the dedicated performances of esteemed voice actors such as Aya Suzaki(Tamako Market, Ajin), Shizuka Ito(Assassination Classroom, Jormungand), Yui Ishikawa(Attack on Titan), Katsuyuki Konishi(Gurren Lagann), and Hiromu Mineta(Giant Beasts of Ars),

[b]Skins, Digital Art Book, and OST[/b]
In addition to the base game, the Digital Deluxe Edition includes seven new character outfits (including illustrations and corresponding sprite animations), special supply items, a digital Art Book, and the game's original soundtrack.

To celebrate the release, we're offering an 18% OFF discount from March 22 to April 4 — the post-discount price will be 20.49 USD for the standard edition and 32.79 USD for the Deluxe Edition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/f1a35e6e79f050357b35c7a406075113fbdf2630.png[/img]

For more details on optimizations and adjustments based on test feedback, such as Tutorials, Convenient Saving, Replay Mode, and character and gameplay updates, refer to our previously released dev blogs.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1127700?emclan=103582791465023695&emgid=3678929839479271729]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1127700?emclan=103582791465023695&emgid=3678929839479271729[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1127700?emclan=103582791465023695&emgid=3216144458729784994]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1127700?emclan=103582791465023695&emgid=3216144458729784994[/url]

As the release date approaches, our team is filled with anticipation. We'll continue pushing forward with development while actively seeking your feedback. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/reversecollapse]Discord[/url] for discussions and real-time updates on game progress, player testing opportunities, and giveaway events. Thank you for your ongoing support!

notes.title: An Update from Sunborn Network on Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery
notes.notes:
Dear agents,

First off, we want to thank you for all your support for Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery. 

The very first trailer for Reverse Collapse was released over two years ago in 2019, and we have not stopped working on this project since. This is a remaster of our first game, Code Name: Bakery Girl (2013), so it represents something special and meaningful to us. This is also an opportunity for us to make up for our shortcomings as an amateur game developer in our earlier years, so our team really went all-in to infuse the script with elaborate storylines, graphics, characters, levels, and mechanics. We hope that the final product will be presented as an exciting new experience that captures the essence of Code Name: Bakery Girl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/1348472293c4685946f1d23462a7b3a9c68cebbc.jpg[/img]

Beyond the visual update and code optimization, we came up with a lot of new and interesting ideas in the development process for Reverse Collapse, some of which have already debuted during live streams and offline demos, while other core content is still undergoing QA and optimization. Therefore, we have decided to move the release to 2022 so that the team can continue to work on the new content until the entire game is complete and polished.

Below you can learn about the development progress and what we will be working on in the following months:

[b]1. Content and structure adjustments[/b]

Reverse Collapse follows the main storyline of Code Name: Bakery Girl (2013), in which the intelligence agency MID of the Antarctic Union carries out Code Name: Bakery in the North Caucasus over the course of two days and one night. It was clear to us that the original script was too short to cover the full extent of this exhilarating mission, so the team has been determined from the very beginning that we would rewrite the script to thoroughly showcase this mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/3f212a08e447d5667440fdbadeb598c695d38c68.png[/img]
 ↑ Main Menu of Code Name: Bakery Girl 

While this is the same 2-day mission, the storyline will feature much more content with captivating details. The current, incomplete script, for example, has a word count eight times longer than that of the original.

To make the storyline more elaborate, the director and our designers have gone through many iterations of the script, sometimes overhauling an almost complete concept. The current structure of the storyline has been redesigned based on the Girls’ Frontline franchise and will be completely new upon the release of the game.  

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/76293bd7a8d297986e18d5dd62860c3fc01d9398.png[/img]

In addition to remastering the original storyline, during the creative process, the team came up with a new vision for how the script should be presented and eventually decided to pursue it by continuing to finetune the existing script structure. In the meantime, the ever-growing Girls’ Frontline franchise requires that new development is accurately reflected in the script of Reverse Collapse.

Therefore, the team can really make use of the extra time to refine the storyline in Reverse Collapse and connect it to the rest of the Girls’ Frontline universe. We are excited for the new script and its presentation to be a novel and impressive experience for our players.

[b]2. Level diversification[/b]

As the storyline became more sophisticated, we had to add many new levels accordingly. Based on how the new script has been structured, the total number of levels in Reverse Collapse will eventually exceed that of the original by several times. Additionally, level placement has been dynamically modified to reflect the script changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/fe943e2fcaeabda59b2d021b3668b1aceaf225e3.png[/img]
↑ Level Map from Code Name: Bakery Girl

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/e4c41472ab0d2d9506ed4422f8ecc732e07fcb91.png[/img]
↑ Level Map from Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery

Levels are a crucial part of the Code Name: Bakery Girl experience. So, when new levels were introduced, we were met with a lot of new challenges. In order to keep players entertained, we introduced more innovative and elaborate gameplay styles to the levels on top of the existing elimination and stealth modes. Moreover, a diverse selection of S-rank challenges have been integrated into the levels for additional replay value. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/055c277eacd88d47c3ca8862c7f159d0096860b9.png[/img]

[b]3. Improving the lore[/b]

As promised, our graphics team has created numerous cutscenes to help immerse players into the game’s lore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/b2cf9b52abee826550a6285e23c124e3af686af7.png[/img]

After multiple rounds of testing and gathering suggestions from both inside and outside of our company, we realized that our static illustrations could not clearly express many key plot points. To help improve the game experience, we decided to combine 2D animations and plot illustrations with dynamic effects to help tell a more vivid story for each of the agents. While these new designs are much more time-consuming to create, especially with all the additional animations and special effects, we are extremely eager to show everyone the results. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/d72bcada4b98ff47046563b76647878f4ecbd636.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502287/36745c16f6a64abae8b55e4daa764ef15339a684.gif[/img]

So that’s where we’re at. The main content for Reverse Collapse has already been developed and we have now entered the home stretch of making final adjustments to the game. We are looking to further optimize every aspect of the game, including an in-depth review of the plot’s logic, a proofread of the plot details, a final optimization of each level, and an improvement to some of our visuals. We hope that Reverse Collapse can become a memorable experience.

Code name: Bakery Girl is a title that contains a lot of history for Mica Team. We hope that Reverse Collapse: Code Name Bakery can help new and original fans of the title alike to experience the charm of the original game while also introducing everyone to the Girls’ Frontline universe. (The development team behind both games are the same and we hope this game’s heart-felt stories can reach an even larger audience through our efforts.)

A big thank you to you agents for your support and understanding. We look forward to sharing more with everyone again!
